authorityPolicy: Per-note sidecar is authoritative. Renderer must not guess when an assignment exists.

BD.reason: Main bass-drum pedal under right foot on standard right-handed setup.

LP.reason: Project label explicitly defines LP as left-foot hi-hat.

LB.reason: Project label explicitly defines LB as left-foot bass drum.

SN.startHandPolicy: Choose a single-stroke alternating start hand phrase-by-phrase; prefer R lead, but choose parity/start so the final hand leaves the immediately following required cymbal/tom hand available. Respect simultaneous-hand conflicts and the authoritative M1-16 precedent.

LC.reason: Preserve existing project right-handed cymbal convention; phrase solver may override only to avoid impossible simultaneous conflict.

TOMS.reason: Use relaxed alternating single strokes for tom fills; restart R after phrase break.

simultaneousPolicies.assignment: must use distinct hands; resolve by instrument-side preference and phrase continuity
